checks.detail: Exact fractions prove feasibility, stationarity, complementarity and matching lower bound 1/4.
17 multipliers in [0,3]; coordinate clipping and separate bound solver agree, q<=1/4; parabola used only through mu=1.
Budget solutions independently satisfy all KKT equations including lower-bound multipliers.
Central differences confirm v prime=-mu, including the differentiable switches.
Three disjoint brackets cross-check polynomial roots; cubic degree exhausts real candidates; coercivity proves existence.
Explicit directions and +/-x^4 show insufficiency of zero gradient and semidefinite Hessian.
Exact powers cross-check all iterates at final step; alpha=0.1 does not decay, 0.105 diverges.
100 deterministic test cases complement direct quadratic derivation; not a proof for arbitrary functions.
Independent linear solve reaches the exact quadratic minimizer.
Both directional derivative and actual objective increase at x=0.1.
Analytic derivatives agree with independent centered differences.
Finite differences verify the residual curvature term; it is nonzero for the specified model.
Profile out amplitude exactly, scan rate grid then scalar refine; confirms candidate, not certified global optimization.
Unique feasible minimizer for min x, x^2<=0 has no stationarity multiplier.
Independent projections and boundary fixed point distinguish ordinary from projected gradient.
Analytic stationarity and independent scalar solver verify finite-parameter violation.
Exact quadratic root verifies stationarity, strict interior and perturbed complementarity.
Subgradient conditions and independent dense one-dimensional comparisons.
Ridge gradient vanishes; valid subgradient +1 at |x| minimum makes any positive step increase the value.
All 16 four-step paths independently match both second-moment formulas.
512 trajectories agree with exact moments within stated finite-sample check; not a general convergence proof.
Exact congruence and independent condition numbers verify equivalent parameterization.
A scaled objective passes a chosen absolute gradient threshold while distance remains sqrt(2).
Three step sizes independently check sign, Jacobian orientation and objective derivative.

scope: Specified models only; calculations supplement analytic arguments; professional review pending.
